about_the_game:
Welcome to Roads of Ruin, a thrilling top-down ARPG extraction experience that seamlessly melds the best elements of ARPGs and high-stakes extractions. Dive headfirst into the fray, battling both players and NPCs to claim the most coveted loot and gear. Whether you thrive in PvP combat or prefer the challenge of tackling unique dungeons and bosses, the choice is yours! Join forces with up to 3 friends, strategically balancing your party roles to outwit and outmaneuver your enemies.

Join our discord to learn more about how to become a beta tester!


What is Roads of Ruin? Rather than use more acronyms, let us describe practically what part of a game session might look like for you and some friends.



You start off in your camp, where you manage your resources, materials and spells to give you the best possible chance in preparation for your next mission. You and three other friends meet in town, collect a quest to retrieve some items from a nearby raided caravan and are ready to start your adventure. You queue into the quest map with dozens of other players- some friend, some foe.



You enter the map with your friends to search for your quest items and whatever else you can find. On your way to your quest objective you find some loot in NPC camps- you take what you can carry. Then, you come across another group of 4 players seeking to complete an entirely different quest. The moment is intense. Both sides sizing each other up and trying to understand each other's motives. One of them decides they would like to wear your armor and attacks. In a strategic MOBA-like battle your team defeats and loots more equipment and resources from the enemy team.



You are hurt from the battle. Decision time. Do you attempt to extract from the map? Or do you continue to try and complete your quest? These situations brought on by a unique blend of PvPvE, ARPG and extraction game mechanics are exactly what makes Roads of Ruin a thrilling game. Dozens of players, all with different motives will create conflict that will lead to a dynamic gameplay experience that you won't find anywhere else.

Your team decides to escape. You sneak past NPC camps, bypass NPC boss fights and make your way to an extraction point.

You live to fight another day, while your foes lost everything in the fight. You take the loot back to your town and your camp to make yourself stronger for the next fight.



Roads of Ruin creates unique stories and play styles by combining the best of several genres. Complete quests and explore a story rich world filled with PvE dungeons, PvP arenas and common city areas to build the story that you and your friends see fit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 with 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600-XT with 6GB+ of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended

short_description: Explore a fractured world as the Radiant and fight to rebuild civilization. Roads of Ruin is a thrilling PvEvP Extraction ARPG hybrid combining the best elements of both genres. Party with up to 3 friends and take on sinister bosses in unique environments while competing with other players for loot.
